localChanges: TypeScript; plain functions returning Otter-shaped comments (time in seconds, size, color, mode number) instead of CCL comment objects (stime in ms).

No DOM: the XML is tokenised with a regular expression over <d p="...">...</d> and the five XML entities plus character references are decoded; upstream parses with DOMParser or, by default, innerHTML into a div after a regex 'escape' (its own comment: do not trust it). Works in Workers and without a document.
Modes 1-6 only: advanced (7, positioned / rotated / path), code (8) and BAS (9) comments are counted as skipped (out of the M5 scope, ADR-012); their parsing is not copied.
Invalid size / color fall back to 25 / white; the colour is masked to 24 bits; dbid (or hash) becomes the comment id.
No console logging of bad comments: they are counted in `skipped`.
